test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Choose the incorrectly spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e.** 'Monitour'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, the word **'Monitour'** is spelled incorrectly. 
 
• The **correct spelling **should be '**Monitor'.**
 
• **"Monitor"** refers to a device used for observing, checking, or keeping a continuous record of a process or quantity.
 
• It can also refer to a person who observes a process or activity to check its compliance with a set of standards.
 
 
• **Example:** She used a heart rate** monitor **during her workout to track her performance.
 
 

Therefore, the** correct answer **is- **'Monitour'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **"Slope"** refers to a surface of which one end or side is at a higher level than another; a rising or falling surface.
 
• **"Constant"** means occurring continuously over a period of time or unchanging over time.
 
• **"Chemical"** refers to a substance produced by or used in a reaction involving changes to atoms or molecules.
